mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 5%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, where the economy is neither too hot nor too cold, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in the 'goldilocks' zone are not significantly different from baseline returns (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window following supply shocks.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 10% in a month indicates increased retail activity, a leading indicator for broader economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with RSAFS growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 0.75%) and high CPIAUCSL (above 220) creates an environment where monetary policy is accommodative but inflation is a concern, leading to mixed S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window in such environments.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (below 5% from above 6% in 2 months) indicates a rapidly improving labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns following such labor market improvements are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 5% in a month, coupled with RSAFS growth above 5%, signals a strong housing market and increased retail spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window when both conditions are met.
